EvangelismRecord.title: EvangelismRecord
EvangelismRecord.description: A record of an individual met during church evangelism outreach by Gospel Labor Ministry.

fullName.description: Full name of the contact person

programs.description: Church programs invited to (e.g. Wednesday Program, Friday Program, Auxano, Sunday Service)

isNewConvert.description: Indicates whether the person gave their life to Christ as a new convert

respondedWell.description: Indicates whether the person responded warmly/receptively to the gospel

notes.description: Follow-up details, address, prayer requests, or comments from the encounter

evangelistName.description: Name of the church worker or evangelist who recorded the contact

date.description: Date of the encounter in YYYY-MM-DD format

followedUp.description: Whether a church worker has completed initial follow-up

followUpNotes.description: Follow-up history, notes, or worker feedback

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated

/records/{recordId}.description: Collection of outreach contacts recorded by GLM members
